title: A paper weight ratio of 1.201 reached zero mean ozone growth response in 13 papers from a 2024 extract
abstract: We tested the direction of mean ozone relative growth-rate responses in 50 records from 13 papers in a 2024 public extract. Six paper means were positive and seven were negative. The equal-paper mean was +2.28 percent. Its conditional 95 percent interval was -19.18 to +29.43 percent under independent, representative paper assumptions. An exact maximum to minimum paper weight ratio of 1.201 reached zero mean. Omitting one paper could change the mean sign. Later regional cells had only one paper each. No selected rate paper also had a final-mass record under the stated labels; one had mass gain. These results do not establish a common ecological benefit or a causal climate effect. Selected outcomes, uncertain paper independence, small control means and mixed methods limit inference. Code, aggregate evidence, source hashes, checks and a figure support reproduction. External source records remain outside the package.

display.caption: Paper mean log growth-rate ratios and exact bounds as maximum to minimum paper weights vary. Bounds are for fixed means, not confidence limits.
